_doc: Harlan's money and his drink (#1292; PlayerPurse, PlayerDrink, BarService; docs/LAYOUT.md 'src/player' and 'src/people'). PROPOSED numbers, to be felt in play. Prices are 1882's in cents (a small-town saloon: whiskey 10-25 cents a glass by the house, a schooner of beer 5, a quart bottle of bar whiskey a dollar and a half); `purse` what Harlan has on him at a new game (he came down the creek with a few dollars); `chip_cents` what a chip at the card table is worth (CardGame buys your stake with it: `stack.you` chips, as many as you can pay for, cashed back as you get up).
_drinks: What the barkeep pours (E at the bar facing him: a tap a whiskey, held past `hold_beer_s` a beer, held past `hold_bottle_s` the bottle; G there stands the house a round, a whiskey a man in the room at `round_cents`). `glass` the kit glass he pours into, `pour_l` what goes in it, `bottle` the kit bottles he pours from (the nearest on his side of the bar; none: he pours all the same and the bar's short a bottle in the log), `units_per_l` drinks of alcohol in a litre (a drink is ~14 g of ethanol: whiskey at 45% ~25 a litre, the day's lager at 4% ~2.3). The bottle: he sets that bottle itself before you, and you drink from it.
_hand: The glass in your left hand (PlayerDrink): `rest` where it's held below your view (camera space, m), `mouth` raised to drink, `raise_s` up and down; fire with no gun out drinks: a sip of `sip_l` (a shot glass's whole shot in one: `shot_l` and under goes at once), `swig_l` from a bottle. E sets it down on what's in front of you within `set_reach` (the bar, a table), else drops it; a gun drawn drops it too. `reach` how far you'd pick a glass up from, `view_deg` how far off the middle of your view.
_dial: What drink does (PlayerDrink's `units` in the blood). What's drunk goes into the blood over `absorb_h` game hours (half of what's left each `absorb_h`) and leaves at `burn_per_h` units a game hour (the liver's steady rate: about a drink an hour), by the clock (a sleep's jump burns it too); with the clock held (noon held) by `held_hour_s` real seconds to the game hour. Effects, nothing faked over the view (no blur, no tint, no doubled sight): the gun's sway grows by `sway_per` a unit, by `sway_more` a unit more past `sway_from`; the aim settles slower (the time to settle times 1 + `settle_per` a unit); the nerve (PlayerComposure) a little steadier round one drink (rattled builds and a flinch jolts at `courage` of their own, the most at `courage_at` units, gone by `courage_to`); past `body_from` your body sways (the view drifts, at most `body_deg` a unit over it, slowly, `body_hz`) and your walk weaves (`weave_deg` a unit over it off the way you push); `drunk_at` the barkeep and the room call you drunk; `cut_off` he won't pour you another.
_bar: The barkeep's side (BarService): he serves from his counter (his block's `do` `counter`) when you're within `serve_m` of him over the bar; a gun out in your hand and he won't (`gun`); he sets the glass `glass_off` m in from the bar's edge in front of you; an empty glass on the bar `collect_s` with nobody holding it he takes away (a full one he leaves); a glass broken on his floor: a word. Answers (DESIGN §2 pillar 6): a round bought, the room answers and it's news; you stood at the bar drinking with nobody within `alone_m` for `alone_s`, a man drinking alone gets a word (once a night); the deputy (StoryState nolaw.deputy) served or drinking, a word at once and it's news; drunk (`drunk_at`), a word from the barkeep and the room, regard, news.
